newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan seen reshaping National Investment Trust.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan seen reshaping National Investment Trust.

text.p: Karachi Stock Exchange president Arif Habib said on Thursday the government planned to reshape operations of the National Investment Trust (NIT), one of the biggest buyers of stocks at the country's three bourses.
"The government has taken an initiative to strengthen the NIT to enable it to support the stock market," he told Reuters.
This could help NIT, an open-ended mutual fund, to regain its previous strength after what he called a deterioration of its financial position over the past few months, Habib said.
He did not say what changes the government envisaged for the state-run NIT. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
